current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照并利用图自编码器重构误差训练节点表征，结合循环神经网络学习时间维度依赖，高效生成动态图的高质量低维表征。
current_point.claim_en: Propose GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots via graph summarization and trains node representations using a graph autoencoder with reconstruction error, then employs a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies, efficiently generating high-quality low-dimensional representations for dynamic graphs.
source_locations: 论文摘要及正文中关于GSAERU模型描述部分
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
采用图摘要技术对单时间步图快照进行压缩
将压缩后的图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
使用循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step
Compress graph snapshots at each time step using graph summarization technology
Feed compressed graphs into a graph autoencoder and train original node representations with reconstruction error against the original graph
Use a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies of the original graph
